title: CVE-2026-109282 — ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 Undefined Behavior in INFO, JSON and YAML Encoders
summary: Affected: ImageMagick ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 contains a type confusion flaw in the INFO, JSON and YAML encoders, where an internal method receives a pointer of an unexpected type when writing an image in a compressed format. An attacker who can cause such an image write can trigger a SIGABRT or SIGSEGV, crashing the process and causing denial of service.

title: CVE-2026-109277 — ImageMagick before 7.1.2-32 Policy Bypass via -script Operation
summary: Affected: ImageMagick ImageMagick before 7.1.2-32 contains a policy bypass vulnerability in the -script operation due to missing checks on file descriptor handling. Attackers can use the -script operation to close file descriptors not opened by the current operation, circumventing configured security policies.

title: CVE-2026-109272 — ImageMagick 7.1.1-31 before 7.1.2-32 Null Pointer Dereference in PostScript Decoder
summary: Affected: ImageMagick ImageMagick 7.1.1-31 before 7.1.2-32 contains a NULL pointer dereference in the PostScript decoder that is triggered when a policy limit is reached. Attackers can supply a crafted PostScript file for processing to crash the application, causing a denial of service.

title: CVE-2026-109267 — ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 Stack Overflow in MSL Decoder
summary: Affected: ImageMagick ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 contains a stack overflow in the MSL decoder caused by an incorrect depth check that fails to limit recursion. Attackers can supply a set of crafted MSL images that exhaust the stack when one of them is read, crashing the process and causing a denial of service.

title: CVE-2026-109262 — ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 Memory Leak in SVG Encoder
summary: Affected: ImageMagick ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 contains a memory leak in the SVG encoder (WriteSVGImage) that fails to release allocated memory when handling crafted images. Attackers can supply crafted image files that are processed by the SVG encoder to leak memory and cause a denial of service through resource consumption.

title: CVE-2026-96537 — Tutor LMS < 4.1.1 - Unauthenticated Tutor Page Force-Publish and Content Overwrite
summary: Affected: Unknown Tutor LMS The Tutor LMS  WordPress plugin before 4.1.1 does not perform a capability check in a routine that regenerates its managed pages, allowing unauthenticated users to force-publish unpublished pages and overwrite their content, create missing ones, and change the options that reference them.

title: CVE-2026-92429 — Rede Itaú for WooCommerce 3.7.1 - 5.5.2 - Unauthenticated Order Status Manipulation via maxiPago Debit Webhook
summary: Affected: Unknown Rede Itaú for WooCommerce The Rede Itaú for WooCommerce WordPress plugin before 5.5.3 does not verify the authenticity of a payment gateway webhook before updating an order's status, allowing unauthenticated attackers to change the status of arbitrary WooCommerce orders, including marking unpaid orders as paid and cancelling completed orders.

title: CVE-2026-92428 — Rede Itaú for WooCommerce < 5.5.3 - Unauthenticated Order Status Manipulation via 3DS Failure Webhook
summary: Affected: Unknown Rede Itaú for WooCommerce The Rede Itaú for WooCommerce WordPress plugin before 5.5.3 does not verify the authenticity of a payment gateway webhook before updating an order's status, allowing unauthenticated attackers to change the status of arbitrary WooCommerce orders, including orders that were already paid or completed.

title: CVE-2026-74920 — Document Gallery <= 5.1.1 - Reflected XSS via data-shortcode Attribute
summary: Affected: Unknown Document Gallery The Document Gallery WordPress plugin through 5.1.1 does not properly sanitise and escape user input before reflecting it inside an HTML attribute in the response of an unauthenticated AJAX action, leading to a Reflected Cross-Site Scripting vulnerability which can be exploited against any visitor, including a logged-in administrator.

title: CVE-2026-63161 — Omnispace Agora Project < 26.10.0 Session Fixation via Authentication
summary: Affected: Omnispace Agora Project Omnispace Agora Project before 26.10.0 contains a session fixation vulnerability that allows remote attackers to hijack authenticated sessions by planting a known session identifier in a victim's browser prior to login. Attackers can exploit the application's failure to regenerate the session id upon successful authentication to gain unauthorized access to the victim's authenticated session after they log in.
